checks.reason: The profile tone notes say to use the customer's first name. The body opens "Hey, join us..." with no name, so it reads like a generic blast.
checks.fix: Open with the greeting plus the customer's first name using the template's first-name field, e.g. "Hey [First name],".

checks.reason: No em-dashes, no emojis, no banned words.
The CTA "Book a table" implies bookings are available, but the profile has no booking link, phone number or booking policy. It is not supported by any source.
checks.fix: Replace the CTA with something the sources support, e.g. "Show this at the till", or drop it. Ask the owner if booking is possible.

checks.reason: Audience 18 matches the segment. The £2.50 value matches the Karak Chai price. 6 redemptions from 37 emailed matches cmp_2.
Saturday 17 October 2026 is a Saturday. Send is Friday 16 October at 10am, in the future. 12pm to 4pm is within Saturday hours (12:00 to 00:00).
Mixed Grill Platter and Karak Chai match the menu.
No causal claims. The expected outcome is framed as the last similar offer's result.
No food, halal or allergen claims.
Offer terms are clear: what, when and conditions. No fake urgency. Free item is an approved type.
Whole list, no targeting by personal traits.
Subject is under 50 characters, headline is 6 words, body is under 60 words. Offer is within the cap and on the menu. Last campaign was 6 October, more than a week ago.
Template header and brand styling are consistent.
No-photo template version used, which is allowed with no photo library.
Copy fits and reads well on a phone.
"Book a table" shows as plain text with no button or link. It looks like an empty or broken CTA slot, and the only real button says "Show at the till".
checks.fix: Remove the CTA or replace it with plain wording that matches the template button, e.g. "See you on Saturday".
